correctness.rationale: Hamming automorphisms S_4 wr S_d fixing ordered markers classify all vertices by coordinate equality-pattern π and represented-symbol status σ or one aggregate unrepresented status *. Each profile count u_{πσ} has exact multinomial orbit size times (4−kπ)^{uπ*}; weak-composition products give number of orbits. The one-neighbor distance-displacement multiset plus distance vector and fixed marker pattern totals equals T_ru for explicit integer columns π,σ and rows δ∈{−1,0,1}^r, π-total and marker distances. Independent JS reconstruction from the actual frozen kernel_basis.json (blob 7998fb9ad90380b5d33dc68f25b05c0fb8b59094) computed modular ranks (2,5,15,51,182) at r=1..5, column counts (2,5,15,51,187), verified ALL five sparse integer null vectors annihilate every one of 299 r=5 rows and are independent mod 1000003. Thus rational rank exactly 182; for r≤4 full modular rank proves Q-full rank. An r=5 first vector has one positive and negative status per 12 distinct patterns, inducing two inequivalent H(12,4) vertices with identical distances and all one-neighbor displacements; direct graph construction corroborates. Individualized marker-distance layers become 1-WL distinguishable by depth d, so one further refinement round recovers T_r u and, for r≤4, the orbits. This does NOT imply stable 1-WL fails at five markers. Additional independently written exhaustive H(2,4) checks corroborated orbit/refinement equivalence. Exact finite integer certificate, not approximate rank or extrapolation.

originality.rationale: Gillespie and Praeger arxiv:1405.5427 give the Hamming automorphism wreath product and investigate neighbor-transitive code actions but not individually colored one-WL orbit equality or the rank of the marker-neighbor tomography matrix. Kersting et al., AAAI 2014, formalize counting color refinement/coarsest equitable partitions with power iteration, not 4-marker H(d,4) universal orbit separation. Recent individualization-refinement papers (e.g. Bhattacharjee et al. arxiv:2605.19702) describe abstract Tinhofer graph property and testing but do not state these exact 51/187-column rank results in the inspected accessible statements; uninspected source is residual priority risk. Published Resultary search found Hamming spectral problems and unrelated colored-code orbit work, no full theorem. The 5-dimensional kernel is a complete natural tomographic obstruction, not an abstract graph-isomorphism impossibility. Prior automorphism-orbit formulas alone do not determine one-neighbor identifiability.

value.rationale: The pointwise-marker orbit partition of H(d,4) is a natural symmetry invariant, and algorithmically recovering it by a fixed number of individualizations is a meaningful graph-isomorphism structural question. The universal integer tomography matrix and its first noninjective marker count give a sharp, precisely scoped information boundary, with a concrete finite collision and a separate all-d orbit theorem. This is not simply computing a known graph diameter or routine WL implementation.

limitations: Four-marker exact orbit-recovery theorem only for alphabet size four; no claim d+1 is optimal.
Five-marker kernel refutes only one-neighbor distance tomography, not eventual WL refinement.
Kernel verified over integers plus modular rank, not relying solely on printed verification logs.
